headline: Purchasing Assistant
summary: Business administration graduate looking for a purchasing assistant role. During my OJT with a construction company's purchasing team I prepared purchase orders, canvassed suppliers and kept the purchasing files complete. I am careful with numbers and paperwork.

projects.name: Supplier canvass template
projects.description: Built an Excel template that compares three supplier quotations side by side, now used by the purchasing team for every request.

projects.name: School canteen purchasing study
bullets: Studied how four school canteens in Molave buy their supplies.
Recommended weekly bulk buying, which one canteen adopted.

experience.title: Purchasing Intern (OJT)
bullets: Prepared about 30 purchase orders a week for cement, steel and hardware items.
Encoded supplier quotations and kept purchase request and PO files complete for audit.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, major in Operations Management
